problem: Consider a function $f(t)$ for which the Laplace transform is $L{f(t)}=F(s).$ How can we obtain the graph of $L{{e}^{8t}f(t)}$ from the graph of $F(s)?$

choices.value: Shift the graph of $F(s)$ by $8$ units to the left.
Shift the graph of $F(s)$ by $8$ units to the right.
Scale the graph of $F(s)$ by a scale factor of $8$ vertically.
Scale the graph of $F(s)$ by a scale factor of $8$ horizontally.
